name: Shirasagi Mayuri
source:
Mayuri is the very calm senpai who is the other “idol” in the school. She is best friends with [url=/c807]Sakurako[/url] and has an onee-san type of personality. Mayuri is the vice-president of the student council. She has a kind and elegant personality, and excels in academics and sports.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flyable_Heart]Wikipedia[/url] and [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/05/24/flyable-heart-review/]Liemyx's review[/url]]
